n893532aace.headline: U.N. nuclear chief says inspectors will visit Iran, but Iran says only after final deal
n893532aace.summary: The head of the UN nuclear agency said Iran's enrichment sites would be inspected under the interim deal. Iran insists any visit will only happen after a final agreement.
n893532aace.why: Iran's nuclear program and related sanctions affect regional security and oil supply expectations, which investors track closely.

n39e314a2ba.headline: Greek 6-Month Bonds Yield 2.24%
n39e314a2ba.summary: The Greek government issued €400 million in six-month bonds at a 2.24% yield, up from 2.21% previously. Demand for the issue was strong.
n39e314a2ba.why: Short-term government bond auctions show the cost of short-term borrowing and investor appetite for Greek sovereign debt.

n9f51278939.headline: Dutch Investors Keen to Explore Areas Beyond Oil and Gas as Cumulative Investments Hit $124 Billion
n9f51278939.summary: Dutch investors are keen to explore areas beyond oil and gas, the report says, as cumulative Dutch investments reach $124 billion.
n9f51278939.why: Foreign direct investment flows shape a host economy's diversification and capital access.

nf0a4062a2b.headline: Sensex Surges 790 Points, Nifty Reclaims 24,000 As IT And Banking Stocks Rally
nf0a4062a2b.summary: Indian benchmarks ended sharply higher on Wednesday, led by IT, banking and realty stocks. The Sensex rose 790 points and the Nifty closed above 24,000, despite weakness in auto and metal shares.
nf0a4062a2b.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the main benchmark indices of India's equity market, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
nf0a4062a2b.why_moved: Strong buying in IT, banking and realty stocks lifted the index, with positive sentiment supporting broad gains despite weakness in autos and metals.

n6f862cde5c.headline: Hits and misses in the FY 2026/27 national budget
n6f862cde5c.summary: Newly appointed Finance Minister Henry Musasizi read the FY2026/27 budget speech. The plan repeats the previous theme of monetising the economy through agriculture, industry, services and digital transformation.
n6f862cde5c.why: The national budget sets government spending, taxes and priorities that shape growth and borrowing needs. Investors track it for fiscal policy and sovereign credit implications.

nbd9bc27b4f.headline: Islamabad memorandum has become declaration of US defeat, Iran legislature head says
nbd9bc27b4f.summary: Iranian parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said the Islamabad memorandum of understanding with the United States was not the result of pressure. He described it as a declaration of US defeat.
nbd9bc27b4f.why: A memorandum between Iran and the United States could shape sanctions relief and Middle East energy supply expectations. Political rhetoric around such deals can influence risk sentiment in oil markets.

n8d868619d5.headline: Athens & European Markets Trade Mixed
n8d868619d5.summary: Athens shares rose modestly amid geopolitical strain while European indices fell slightly. Brent crude eased to $76 a barrel.
n8d868619d5.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market, and Brent is the global benchmark for crude oil prices.

n7da83de7d3.headline: EU Funds Absorption at 29.6% – Greece’s Race to Spend
n7da83de7d3.summary: Greece has absorbed just 29.6% of EU funds under the 2021-2027 budget. The next three years are critical for accelerating disbursements and driving growth.
n7da83de7d3.why: EU cohesion and recovery funds are a major source of public investment in Greece, so their pace of use affects growth.

n37a8182472.headline: Hanwha Aerospace to produce K9 Howitzers in UAE
n37a8182472.summary: Hanwha Aerospace is partnering with a United Arab Emirates defence company to pursue local production of its K9 self-propelled howitzer. The move strengthens its presence in the Gulf.
n37a8182472.why: Hanwha Aerospace is a South Korean defence manufacturer, and export and local-production deals drive its defence order book.

ndd65cbbacc.headline: Increase in Dollar Index - Economy Southeast AgNET
ndd65cbbacc.summary: Rising Treasury yields and a stronger dollar are pressuring commodity and technology markets. Analysts are watching grain trade and crude oil.
ndd65cbbacc.why: The US dollar and Treasury yields affect the price of dollar-denominated commodities and the valuation of growth equities. Higher yields raise borrowing costs across the economy.

nb8ea7a24ad.headline: Katseli Law Reform: 100,000+ Borrowers Get Relief
nb8ea7a24ad.summary: Greece has resolved 16 years of uncertainty over the Katseli Law, delivering retroactive debt relief to more than 100,000 borrowers. The relief comes with €700 million in shared costs.
nb8ea7a24ad.why: The Katseli Law governs debt settlement for Greek borrowers, and its resolution affects household credit quality and the country's banking system.

ncef3a90b7b.headline: Airbnb Block Change, Property Prices Slow Down
ncef3a90b7b.summary: Greece has updated short-term rental rules, while property price growth is cooling and housing loans have surged. The report also cites a drop in Golden Visa applications.
ncef3a90b7b.why: Short-term rental regulation and housing credit affect Greek property values and foreign investment flows.

nba65b1d0d2.headline: Bessent: Inflation will come down as AI stands to double productivity
nba65b1d0d2.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a speech that he expects inflation to start coming down and that AI will at least double productivity. He also said the administration is working to position the economy for success.
nba65b1d0d2.why: The Treasury Secretary leads US fiscal and economic policy and speaks for the administration on inflation and growth. Views on inflation shape expectations for Federal Reserve policy and Treasury yields.

n030277e381.headline: Bank of Greece: Digital Payments vs Tax Evasion
n030277e381.summary: The Bank of Greece called for wider use of electronic payments and tax incentives to reduce tax evasion. It said such measures would also narrow the VAT gap.
n030277e381.why: The Bank of Greece is the country's central bank and supervises its banking system. Tax compliance and the VAT gap affect public finances and sovereign debt sustainability.

n3567c77f23.headline: Skouries Mine Puts Greece on EU Critical Materials Map
n3567c77f23.summary: Eldorado Gold's $3 billion Skouries copper-gold project in Halkidiki is positioning Greece as a key EU supplier of critical raw materials. The materials are used in electric vehicles and renewable energy.
n3567c77f23.why: Eldorado Gold is a Canadian-listed gold miner with projects in Greece and Turkey. Copper and critical minerals are central inputs for EVs, grid infrastructure and renewables.

nb90914933a.headline: Attica Department Stores Lists on Euronext Athens
nb90914933a.summary: Attica Department Stores has begun its public offering ahead of a listing on Euronext Athens on 2 July 2026. The article describes the listing as a milestone in the company's 20-year evolution.
nb90914933a.why: Attica is a Greek department store chain, and an IPO raises capital and brings a new listing to the Athens exchange. Initial public offerings are a key indicator of market appetite for domestic consumer companies.

n095e6561f4.headline: Mitsotakis: Fuel Prices to Normalize Soon
n095e6561f4.summary: Prime Minister Mitsotakis told President Tasoulas that fuel prices are easing and announced new support measures backed by Greece's fiscal strength.
n095e6561f4.why: Government fuel support measures affect household energy costs and the public finances of Greece.

n0bf215c557.headline: Carlyle reportedly puts Very Group up for sale at £2bn valuation
n0bf215c557.summary: Carlyle reportedly plans to sell Very Group at a £2bn valuation. The US private equity firm took control of Very in November 2025 for a nominal £1 after the Barclay family lost ownership.
n0bf215c557.why: Carlyle is a large US private equity firm, and sales of retail groups at set valuations indicate private capital activity in UK retail.

n4e3cc3e0c0.headline: Inflation lying in wait to strike another rate blow
n4e3cc3e0c0.summary: Headline inflation fell, but a larger-than-expected rise in the underlying measure leaves room for another interest rate increase. The article describes the figures as keeping the door open to further tightening.
n4e3cc3e0c0.why: Underlying inflation is the measure the Reserve Bank of Australia watches most closely, so it shapes expectations for cash rate decisions and Australian bond yields.

n43a996b712.headline: S&P Cuts India FY27 Growth Outlook, Flags 6.6% GDP Amid Energy And Monsoon Risks
n43a996b712.summary: S&P Global Ratings expects India's GDP growth to slow to 6.6% in FY27 and warned inflation could rise to 5.1%, raising rate hike concerns.
n43a996b712.why: S&P Global Ratings is a major credit rating agency whose macroeconomic forecasts influence investor views on sovereign and corporate credit.

n2ed030f990.headline: S&P 500, Nasdaq rise as oil drops and Micron earnings loom
n2ed030f990.summary: US stock indexes rose as Brent crude fell toward its last prewar close, while tech shares steadied after a global selloff. Micron's earnings are due soon.
n2ed030f990.why: The S&P 500 tracks the largest US listed companies, and the Nasdaq is weighted toward technology stocks that are sensitive to chip-sector results.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: US large-cap benchmark rose on the day according to the headline.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n2ed030f990.why_moved: Brent crude fell toward its pre-war level, easing inflation and energy concerns, while tech stocks steadied after a global selloff.

n049f4fb9bb.headline: Inflation lying in wait to strike another rate blow
n049f4fb9bb.summary: Headline inflation fell, but a larger-than-expected rise in underlying inflation leaves room for another interest rate increase, according to the source. Figures are for Australia.
n049f4fb9bb.why: Underlying inflation is the measure central banks watch most closely when setting interest rates, so it drives bond yields and the Australian dollar.

n9dd92aa468.headline: Nandan Nilekani Says AI Will Amplify Infosys, Not Replace IT Services Model
n9dd92aa468.summary: Infosys Chairman Nandan Nilekani said AI will strengthen IT services firms that adapt quickly. He cited enterprise complexity and legacy system upgrades as sources of continued demand.
n9dd92aa468.why: Infosys is one of India's largest IT services exporters, so its view on AI shapes expectations for the sector's revenue outlook.

nc414b80c9b.headline: Oil prices plunge over $3 on Hormuz supply relief
nc414b80c9b.summary: Oil prices plunged more than $3 a barrel on relief over Strait of Hormuz supply. The move reflects reduced concern about disruption to crude flows through the key chokepoint.
nc414b80c9b.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so supply concerns there move benchmark crude prices quickly.
nc414b80c9b.why_moved: Relief over Strait of Hormuz supply reduced the risk premium in crude, pushing oil prices down by more than $3.

n54151dd3fb.headline: Pak-Iran trade gets boost with Taftan customs station
n54151dd3fb.summary: A new customs station at Taftan is expected to boost trade between Pakistan and Iran, according to The Express Tribune.
n54151dd3fb.why: Cross-border trade facilitation affects Pakistan's regional commerce and logistics costs.

nfc049ae76b.headline: WTI Holds Losses As Cushing Hits 'Tank Bottoms', US Production At Record Highs
nfc049ae76b.summary: WTI crude held its losses as Cushing, Oklahoma, stocks reached tank bottoms, the lowest level for this time of year since 2004. US production is at record highs.
nfc049ae76b.why: Cushing is the delivery hub for the WTI futures contract, so low inventories there can tighten nearby supply and affect WTI pricing.

nd73bf4ee20.headline: Stocks edge lower as dollar rises to one-year high
nd73bf4ee20.summary: Stocks fell on Wednesday, erasing early Wall Street gains, while European shares were little changed. Valuation worries continued to weigh on the market as the dollar rose to a one-year high.
nd73bf4ee20.why: The US dollar's strength affects multinational earnings, commodity prices and capital flows, and Wall Street sentiment influences global equity markets.
nd73bf4ee20.why_moved: Valuation worries weighed on stocks, which gave up early gains, while a stronger dollar reached a one-year high.

n92304ba5ba.headline: Lazada joins growing list of firms cutting jobs in Singapore. Here are the others
n92304ba5ba.summary: E-commerce platform Lazada is among companies cutting jobs in Singapore this year, according to a STOMP report listing recent retrenchments. No number of job losses was given in the input.
n92304ba5ba.why: Lazada is a Southeast Asian e-commerce platform owned by Alibaba. Workforce reductions reflect cost pressures and restructuring in the regional online retail market.

n5fc835a848.headline: Iran offering
n5fc835a848.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said Wednesday that Iran was making significant concessions in ongoing negotiations and expressed optimism ahead of a new round of talks.
n5fc835a848.why: Negotiations over Iran's nuclear and regional posture influence oil supply expectations, since Iran is a major crude producer.

nf832899b44.headline: Paradigm Gold Corporation: Paradigm Gold Provides Corporate Update
nf832899b44.summary: Paradigm Gold Corporation reported that all resolutions in its recent notice were passed, providing a corporate update.
nf832899b44.why: Corporate updates and shareholder resolutions can affect company governance and strategic direction, relevant to investors.
